title: Basement-surface differential geometry as View A, cross-family consensus for novel mass, and a lane-feasible constrained placement

gates.S1_sufficiency: View A out-of-quadrant AUC mean >= 0.60 and every fold >= 0.55
gates.S2_independence: abandon co-training at |pearson| or |spearman| of block OOF negative errors >= 0.60
gates.canary: any single feature with holdout AUC > 0.90 is leakage until proven otherwise
gates.format: single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform (100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550), values in [0,1], all finite
gates.lane_literal: Spearman <= 0.90 and directed 3px near-dot <= 0.70 against every aligned prior
gates.lane_policy: the same rule restricted to informative priors (3px coverage of the legal set < 0.95)
gates.uniqueness: decoded pattern not identical to any prior and not the literal prior union
gates.not_union: the emission is not the union of the round's two view fields

rho_novel_prior_source: revealed.calibrate().reference_densities (uniform random over the legal set; champion file average)
verdict_rule: promote requires format AND uniqueness AND lane AND not-union AND S1 AND holdout paired CI lower bound above single_B > 0; otherwise negative
